activities: Custom metal fabrication for commercial, industrial, and residential applications
Custom metal signs and architectural awnings

Metal gates, fences, stairs, and railings

problems.problem: Custom fabrication quote requests arriving via web forms with uploaded sketches or images may require manual triage, routing, and follow-up by estimators or project managers.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The website uses a basic web form with file upload ('Upload your Idea Here (16M Max)') and displays no customer portal or automated quoting/scheduling tool, though internal ERP or shop management workflows cannot be observed from the public site.

existingSolutions.solution: Fabrication shop management / ERP software (such as JobBOSS, ECI M1, FabSuite, or Fulcrum)
existingSolutions.addresses: Estimating, RFQ intake, CAD/CAM nesting integration, work order routing, and shop floor tracking for custom metal fabricators

feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because Boise Metal Works is a custom metal fabrication and manufacturing shop outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led HVAC, plumbing, and electrical home-service contractors.

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is outside ForgeX's target segment.

humanReview: No implementation is recommended; in any custom metal fabrication workflow, engineering drawings, material specifications, structural code compliance, and custom quotes require human estimator and fabricator sign-off.

risks.description: Custom metal fabrication involves bespoke engineering specifications, structural tolerances, and commercial/residential building codes that cannot be quoted or routed using templates designed for residential HVAC, plumbing, or electrical service calls.

assumptions: Although the FAQ page states a general shop rate of $95 per hour ('Our shop rate is $95 an hour and is subject to change.'), Boise Metal Works is outside ForgeX's target segment and no ForgeX service is recommended.

questions: How are incoming custom fabrication quote requests and uploaded customer drawings currently routed and tracked from initial inquiry through estimating?
What shop management, ERP, or accounting software do you currently use alongside your water jet nesting software?
Approximately how many staff members work across your fabrication shop, field welding crew, and office?

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identity, address, phone number, principal metal fabrication and manufacturing services, dedicated point of contact policy, and technical script/form inventory.
Company founding history (1994), heritage from Boise Spring Works (1917), and identification of founders [redacted] and [redacted].
Published shop rate ($95/hour), materials handled, painting vs. powder coating capabilities, and residential/commercial stair and railing code references.
Service area verification (Boise, Treasure Valley, Eastern Oregon), physical address, phone number, and project inquiry form with file upload.
Shop equipment list (Vf4 CNC machine, 9' x 13' CNC water jet, shear, press brake, rollers, shop/field welding) and confirmation of geometric part-nesting software.
Confirmation of custom design and metal fabrication focus across industrial, commercial, and residential applications.

limitations: Employee headcount is not stated on the public website.
No contractor license numbers or state business registration details are published on the website.
No direct email address is published on the pages read (only a phone number and Contact Form 7 web forms).
Internal ERP, estimating, CAD/CAM vendor names, and accounting systems cannot be verified from the public website.
Whether the company pays for digital leads is not verifiable from the website (though gtag.js is present, no paid search landing pages or call-tracking scripts were observed).

qualification.rationale: ForgeX serves owner-led home-service contractors in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical with roughly 10 to 75 staff who pay for leads. Boise Metal Works is a custom metal fabrication, machining, water-jet cutting, and manufacturing company serving industrial, commercial, and residential clients. Because its core industry and job-shop manufacturing workflows fall outside ForgeX's target home-service contractor segment, it is not a fit.
